description:
Provides additional Excel worksheet, selection, and cell information for NVDA users.
Announces the worksheet name and its position in the workbook when you change sheets,
the size of the current selection (rows and columns), the current cell address, and the workbook name.
Also announces when the sheet rename box is open and the result of renaming.
Includes an Easy Excel settings panel and manual commands:
NVDA+F1 (Easy Excel Information window), NVDA+Alt+S (worksheet),
NVDA+Alt+R (selection), NVDA+Shift+Up Arrow (overall selection),
NVDA+Alt+C (current cell), and NVDA+Alt+W (workbook name).
changelog:
Added the Easy Excel Information window (NVDA+F1) with overview, print areas, page breaks, headers and footers, page setup, formulas, and spell checking.
Added manual commands for worksheet, selection, overall selection, current cell, and workbook name reporting.
Added settings panel to customize automatic announcements for worksheets, selections, and current cell addresses.
Added automatic announcement for the sheet rename box and rename results.
